issues.title: Missing Verifies clauses for Phase 01-06
issues.why: While 00-overview has ACs with Verifies clauses in 97-acceptance-criteria.md, the actual technical phases (01-06) lack granular GWT/Verifies pairs for their specific architectural requirements.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verification' section to each phase file (01-06) with explicit GWT criteria and a 'Verifies:' line referencing the specific architectural invariant.

issues.title: Unresolved External References in Consistency Report
issues.why: The 99-consistency-report.md identifies several broken external links (e.g., formatting-rules-reference.md) and marks them as 'RESOLVED' in prose, but the 'Recommended Fixes' section still lists them as P0/P1 actions, creating ambiguity for an AI.
issues.fix: Remove the 'Recommended Fixes' P0/P1 table entries for items already marked as RESOLVED in the status tables.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions Unaddressed
issues.why: The spec covers file logging and database migrations but does not specify handling for concurrent requests (e.g., file locking for FileLogger or race conditions in the self-update/rollback logic).
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency' section to Phase 04 (Logging) and Phase 10 (Deployment) specifying flock() or atomic operation requirements.
